# Şahin Alpay

> Official website of Şahin Alpay (b. 18 April 1944, Istanbul) — Turkish political
> scientist, author and journalist from an Ayvalık family.

## About

- His family roots extend to Ayvalık, Lesbos and Serres. He attended school in
  Istanbul and spent the 1961–62 school year in California on an AFS scholarship.
- Graduated from Ankara University, Faculty of Political Sciences (1967); Ph.D. in
  political science, Stockholm University (1981).
- Sought refuge in Sweden in 1972. His political thinking moved from revolutionary
  Marxism towards social liberalism during his years there.
- Columnist for Cumhuriyet (1982–92), Sabah (1993–94), Milliyet (1994–2001) and
  Zaman (2002–2016). Taught at Bahçeşehir, Boğaziçi and Princeton universities.
- Detained after the July 15, 2016 coup attempt and held for roughly twenty months.
  Turkey's Constitutional Court and the European Court of Human Rights ruled his
  detention violated his fundamental rights; he was released in 2018.
- Married Fatma in 1965; she died on 6 October 2018. Their life together is central
  to his two memoirs, Bir Hikâyem Var and Hikâyemin Sonu.
- The life story at /tr/kimdir and /about is his own first-person biography text.

## Selected works

- Hikâyemin Sonu (2025) — memoir
- Bir Hikâyem Var (2024) — memoir
- Türkiye'nin Tanıkları: İçeriden Bakanlar (2003)
- Türkiye'nin Tanıkları: Dışarıdan Bakanlar (2002)
- DSP-SHP: Nerede Birleşiyor, Nerede Ayrılıyorlar? (1986) — with Seyfettin Gürsel
- Turkar i Stockholm: en studie av invandrare, politik och samhälle (1980) — doctoral-era study, in Swedish

## Site

- Homepage: https://sahinalpay.com/ — biography, selected works, and contact.
- His own account of the criminal proceedings against him — arrest, courtroom
  statements, and the Constitutional Court's and European Court of Human
  Rights' rulings in his case — is at /tr/yargilanma-surecim, in Turkish. A
  short English-language factual summary of the case is at /trial-process.
- Archive: 615 catalogued pieces across Cumhuriyet, Sabah, Milliyet, Zaman,
  Today's Zaman and P24, plus political analyses, interviews and academic
  articles. Turkish index at /tr/kose-yazilari, English at /columns.
- Every entry traces to a verifiable source; the archive contains no
  reconstructed or paraphrased text presented as his writing. Where a piece
  survives only as a page scan, the accompanying summary is the archive's,
  clearly labelled as such, and is not his words.
- Sitemap: https://sahinalpay.com/sitemap.xml
